name: Towel Quad Stretch
otherNames: Prone Quad Stretch with a Towel
description: Lying face down with a towel looped round one ankle and the ends held over your shoulder, pull the towel to bring that heel toward your seat until you feel a stretch in the front of the thigh.

source.title: [P]rehab: Prone quad stretch with a strap
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Lie face down, one arm long on the floor past your head.
Loop a towel round one ankle and hold the ends over the same shoulder.

prescription.note: Hips stay down on the floor; stop at a gentle stretch.

keyframes.name: Towel round the ankle
keyframes.cue: Lie face down, a towel round one ankle, the ends over your shoulder.

keyframes.name: Heel to your seat
keyframes.cue: Pull the towel to bring the heel toward your seat.
